resources.string: App monitoring and budgets
App monitoring in ScrollFit

Only the foreground app’s name is checked to calculate usage time and show limits. Screen text, messages, and page content are not read. You choose when to enable monitoring and can stop it at any time.
Choose apps and their daily free time. Monitoring starts only after you tap “Enable.” Time already used is not reset when you change settings, remove an app, or reopen the app.
Required access is missing; limits cannot be enforced.
The monitoring service is not ready. Open ScrollFit and check Accessibility settings.
Access is connected. Monitoring may still have gaps; review recorded usage in ScrollFit.
Preparing monitoring
Another monitoring session is active. Stop the 30-second test or main monitoring first.
The device startup identifier is unavailable. Monitoring has stopped to prevent duplicate time accounting.
Could not save the budget, so monitoring has stopped. Check storage and app status.
Could not show or remove the limit screen; limit enforcement cannot be confirmed.
Monitoring events arrived late, so the uncertain interval was not counted. Reopen the app.
The system stopped monitoring. Check Accessibility settings.
Foreground app details are unavailable. Monitoring has stopped; check again.
Some intervals were not monitored. Unrecorded time does not mean zero usage.
After a restart, Android must reconnect the service for monitoring to continue. If the status remains “Not ready,” check Accessibility settings. Time while the service is disconnected is not counted.
